solutions.title: Sort by distance
solutions.strategy: Sort all values by distance to x and value, take k, then sort the answer.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting all n values dominates the work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A boxed copy of the input values is sorted.

solutions.title: Shrink window
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly remove the worse endpoint until only k values remain.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each step discards exactly one endpoint.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The returned list stores k values.

solutions.title: Binary search window
solutions.strategy: Binary-search the left boundary of the optimal length-k window.

timeComplexity.explanation: The boundary search is logarithmic and copying the answer costs k.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The returned list stores k values.
